## About
Caliber Roofing & Construction is a roofing and construction company based on W Surrey Park in Palos Hills, serving Palos Hills and the surrounding Chicago land area.
We do roof repair, replacement, installation, inspection and maintenance for homes, plus flat roofs and maintenance programs for businesses. Beyond the roof, we install and replace siding and repair and install gutters.
If a storm has damaged your roof, our customers say Magda will walk you through the claim with your insurance company and keep you updated along the way. Call us for a free quote.

## Services
- Residential roofing: Roof repair, replacement and installation, along with roof inspection and maintenance for your home.
- Commercial roofing: Roofing for businesses and commercial properties, including flat roof repair and installation, industrial roofing and roof maintenance programs.
- Gutters and siding: Siding installation and replacement, and gutter repair and installation.
- Storm damage: Repairs and replacement for roofs damaged by storms.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. Reviewers say Magda worked with their insurance company and helped them through the whole claim process.

Q: Is the quote free?
A: Yes. Call us and we will set up a free consultation and estimate.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Palos Hills and work with customers in Palos Hills and the surrounding areas.
